tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
HSGQ-G08L 8-Port GPON OLT – High-Performance FTTH Fiber Access Solution


The HSGQ-G08L GPON OLT is a powerful, carrier-grade 8-Port Optical Line Terminal designed for high-capacity FTTH (Fiber to the Home), FTTB, and FTTx deployments. Built with advanced 10G uplinks, cloud management, and dual power redundancy, this device ensures exceptional stability, performance, and scalability for ISPs, telecom operators, and enterprise networks.


Key Features & Advantages

High-Capacity GPON Access

Equipped with 8 GPON ports, each supporting 1:128 split ratio, allowing up to 1024 ONUs total.

Perfect for large-scale fiber broadband networks and multi-service environments (Internet, IPTV, VoIP).


Powerful Uplink & Connectivity

  • Features 4× Gigabit RJ45, 2× 1G SFP, and 2× 10G SFP+ uplink ports for flexible backbone integration.
  • Ideal for high-bandwidth FTTH and data center interconnections.


Intelligent Network Management


  • Supports Web, CLI, SNMP, and Cloud NMS management interfaces.
  • Easy configuration, remote monitoring, and smart troubleshooting from any location.
  • Fully supports VLAN, QinQ, QoS, ACL, link aggregation, and loop detection for traffic control and security.


Reliable & Redundant Power Design


  • Supports AC 100–240V with optional dual AC/DC redundant power supply, ensuring uninterrupted operation.
  • Ideal for critical network applications requiring high uptime and low maintenance.


Compact & Durable Build


  • 1U rackmount metal chassis (442 × 260 × 44 mm) built for 24/7 enterprise-grade operation.
  • Wide operating range (–10°C to +60°C) suitable for telecom, ISP, and data center environments.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: HSGQ-G08L
  • PON Ports: 8 × GPON SFP slots
  • Split Ratio: Up to 1:128 per PON port
  • Max ONUs: 1024 ONUs total
  • Uplink Ports: 4 × GE RJ45, 2 × 1G SFP, 2 × 10G SFP+
  • Memory / Flash: 1 GB DDR / 32 MB Flash
  • Power Supply: AC 100–240V (optional AC+DC)
  • Power Consumption ≤ 55W
  • Operating Temperature –10°C ~ +60°C
  • Management: Web, CLI, SNMP, NMS, Cloud
  • Dimensions: 442 × 260 × 44 mm (1U)
